entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
Javelin Medium Range Anti-Armour Weapon (MRAAW) 🎯 The Javelin MRAAW is a highly effective anti-armour ‘fire and forget’ missile system used by infantry in the New Zealand Army. This shoulder-fired precision missile is designed to destroy tanks and other armoured vehicles, as well as hovering helicopters.
 
We operate guided missiles across maritime, land and air domains. The anti-ship, anti-armour and anti-air capabilities are controlled by trained sailors, soldiers and aviators across the services.
 
Explore our missile systems ➡️ nzdf.mil.nz/missile-systems
